items.title: Timberborn 1.1 Is Here - Water Pressure Changes Everything
items.description: 1.1 Is Here. And with it, a new way to add water pressure. If you thought Mechanistry would be done with Timberborn after 1.0, you were wrong. Five months after they celebrated the launch of 1.0, Timberborn 1.1 is here with new leisure attractions, a new monument tier, the first arid-land plant, expanded impermeable buildings, and most importantly—pressurized pumping that finally let us make pipes work downstream. Today, I'm doing a traditional update overview in Tutopolis: going over the cost of every new building (science, power, materials and jobs) and adding them to the map where they make the most sense. At the end, I build one classic "Dolthra overengineered structure" that makes the most of all of the new features. What you'll see in this Timberborn 1.1 update overview: • Every new building & cost: leisure attractions, new monuments, succulents • Expanded impermeable buildings: move beavers, tubeways, and power THROUGH your dams without flooding • New pressurized pumping / water pressure system: how to pressurize downstream and push water uphill • Full Tutopolis integration ~ Tutopolis Saves Dropbox (requires account): https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/dgarzfwc08x60lvvvtggb/AHhc_KIpiz9hFsPyAovDmdI?rlkey=pxjcpd1rh35hq6e3p16rfrjaj&st=ukulgswd&dl=0 ~ Patch Notes: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062090/view/713408417186711419?l=english ~ Map Pre-1.0 Waterfalls ~ Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUIhbqG8KSDK88mV0Y_9uOKhI4HAwxbua ~ Socials Discord - https://discord.gg/4zMGpQNUnv ~ Mods None ~ Chapters Intro - 0:00 Tier 4 Monument - 1:53 Succulents - 7:51 Outfit Diversion - 10:37 Saunas - 12:11 Domed Gardens - 16:38 Statistical Views - 17:50 Airlock - 20:20 Impermeable Shafts and Compact Pumps - 26:06 Pressurizing Our Pipes - 31:45 Overengineering a Domed Garden - 38:48 Sluice Change Note - 41:09 Detailing the Build - 47:20 Outro - 48:45

items.title: Corn or Mushrooms? The Ironteeth Food Decision That Changes Everything
items.description: Begindale's sixteen beavers are thriving, but Timberborn colonies are meant to grow into the hundreds. To feed a real population of Ironteeth, you have two main food options: corn rations and fermented mushrooms. In this episode I break down the benefits and drawbacks of each so you can pick the right main course for your colony. Then start the long, long, long climb from where we left last episode to actually producing both. That means scavenging for metal, building a forester, crafting gears, expanding our water wheels, and surviving multiple droughts. * Corn rations vs. fermented mushrooms: which should you build around? * Scavenging metal to unlock metal parts and blocks * Setting up a renewable log supply with a forester * Gears, water wheels, and scaling our power grid * Expanding our population sensibly * Beginning logistics and managing haulers * Surviving droughts with your new infrastructure Which do you prefer, corn or mushrooms? Drop a comment below and let me know how you prefer to feed your ironteeth. ~ Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUIhbqG8KSDJuiOiTkMW3xK_4Qh9bVcZO ~ Map Plains, default map ~ Socials Discord - https://discord.gg/4zMGpQNUnv ~ Mods Rotating Sun - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3343320334 + Dependencies (Harmony, Modsettings) ~ Chapters Intro - 0:00 Staple Foods Explained - 1:48 * Metal Overview - 3:15 Metal Gathering - 4:22 Platforms - 8:10 Placing Storage - 9:50 Colony Cleanup - 10:50 Planting Corn - 14:08 * The Forester - 15:26 Which Trees to Plant? - 19:17 Planting Trees - 20:42 Drought Approaching - 23:13 Mangroves and Berries - 23:48 Gears - 27:17 Drought Job Juggling - 32:42 * Hauling Post - 35:29 Haulers - 42:10 Satisfying Needs - 44:54 Injuries - 49:16 Breeding Pod Extension - 52:25 * Metal Production - 54:58 Diagnosing Problems - 59:53 Drought Job Juggling 2 - 1:03:02 Mangrove Fruits - 1:05:08 ** The Big Question - 1:06:37 * Hydroponic Gardens - 1:10:45 * Corn Rations - 1:23:16 Food Logistics - 1:30:55 Outro - 1:37:24
